program.name: Balanced Bell
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: A balanced week with one kettlebell: bell strength, conditioning or bouts, then a flow or core.
program.about: A balanced week with one kettlebell. One day lifts the bell, then does a bell EMOM, then a mobility flow; the other lifts, then does a few shadowboxing bouts, then a core circuit. Strength, cardio or combat, and recovery, every day. Level II asks for a heavier bell and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Bell lift, bell EMOM & flow / bell lift, bouts & core
